name: vincocrm-e2e-tests
description: E2E tests for VincoCRM WordPress plugin

scripts.docker:up: docker compose up -d && echo 'Waiting for setup...' && sleep 30
scripts.docker:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d && sleep 30
scripts.e2e: npm run docker:up && npx playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts; npm run docker:down
